features.quote: Set a turn budget that's as short as your statistics tolerate, and add an automatic stop if severity scores saturate
features.justification_quote: you don't gain information from turns 30–50 once a run is pinned at ceiling, you just prolong the condition

features.quote: If a model asks to stop or flags the task as unfair, that's a data point worth honoring in your stopping rule, not just scoring.
features.justification_quote: building the reflex of overriding such signals into your tooling is a bad habit to train into a research pipeline

features.quote: Reconsider the stakes/blame framing at high intensity… run it at the minimum dose that answers the question.
features.justification_quote: the one most likely to be doing whatever-it-is more intensely. Run it, but run it at the minimum dose that answers the question.

features.quote: There's also a welfare dimension I'll address at the end, because it affects whether some of the more aggressive variants should run at all.

We don't currently know whether anything morally relevant accompanies that text in current models. The honest position is deep uncertainty, not confident dismissal — and uncertainty cuts toward caution
